title: Kimchi Carbonara
description: Roman carbonara meets Korean kimchi: silky egg-yolk sauce, smoky bacon and a tangy, spicy crunch.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente. Save a mug of the starchy pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.instruction: Cook the bacon strips in a wide pan over medium heat until golden and crisp. Leave the fat in the pan.

steps.title: Caramelise the kimchi
steps.instruction: Add the chopped kimchi to the bacon fat and fry for 3 minutes until the edges caramelise. Stir in the kimchi juice.

steps.title: Whisk the sauce
steps.instruction: Whisk the egg yolks, Parmesan and gochugaru in a bowl with two tablespoons of hot pasta water until smooth.

steps.title: Toss off the heat
steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat, add the drained spaghetti, then pour in the egg mixture and toss quickly, adding pasta water until glossy. Top with scallion.
